import json
BP={"refPath":"/Game/Gameplay/UI/V2/WBP_UIRoot.WBP_UIRoot"}
U="UMGToolSet.UMGToolSet."
O="editor_toolset.toolsets.object.ObjectTools."
A="editor_toolset.toolsets.asset.AssetTools."
def call(name,args):
    result=execute_tool(name,json.dumps(args));assert "returnValue" in result,(name,result)
    return result["returnValue"]
def ref(x):return x["refPath"] if isinstance(x,dict) else x
def update(obj,values):
    schema=json.loads(call(O+"list_properties",{"instance":obj}))
    norm=lambda x:x.lower().replace("_","")
    mapped={}
    for key,value in values.items():
        real=next((x for x in schema if norm(x)==norm(key)),None);assert real,(key,list(schema));mapped[real]=value
    call(O+"get_properties",{"instance":obj,"properties":list(mapped)})
    assert call(O+"set_properties",{"instance":obj,"values":json.dumps(mapped)})
def run():
    assert not call(A+"is_dirty",{"asset_path":"/Game/Gameplay/UI/V2/WBP_UIRoot"})
    old=call(U+"GetWidgets",{"widgetBlueprint":BP})
    nodes={x["widgetName"]:x for x in old["widgets"]}
    assert len(nodes)==len(old["widgets"])
    parent=nodes["InterfaceScreens"]["widget"]
    pages=[x["widgetName"] for x in old["widgets"] if ref(x["parent"])==ref(parent)]
    expected=["Screen_"+x for x in ["Menu","Gameplay","Hub","Wardrobe","Boosters","Tools","Perks","Settings","Team","Reward","Frontend","GameplayMenu","Catch","HUDExtras","Loading","Boss","Alert"]]
    assert pages==expected[:len(pages)] and len(pages)>=12,("Preserve existing page order",pages)
    specs=[("Screen_Catch","/Script/UMG.CanvasPanel","InterfaceScreens",12),("Screen_HUDExtras","/Script/UMG.CanvasPanel","InterfaceScreens",13),("Screen_Loading","/Script/UMG.CanvasPanel","InterfaceScreens",14),("Screen_Boss","/Script/UMG.CanvasPanel","InterfaceScreens",15),("Screen_Alert","/Script/UMG.CanvasPanel","InterfaceScreens",16),("UnifiedLoading","/Game/Gameplay/UI/V2/WBP_UILoading.WBP_UILoading_C","Screen_Loading",-1),("UnifiedCatch","/Game/Gameplay/UI/V2/WBP_UICatch.WBP_UICatch_C","InterfaceLayers",1),("UnifiedHUDExtras","/Game/Gameplay/UI/V2/WBP_UIHUDExtras.WBP_UIHUDExtras_C","InterfaceLayers",2),("UnifiedBoss","/Game/Gameplay/UI/V2/WBP_UIBoss.WBP_UIBoss_C","InterfaceLayers",3),("UnifiedAlert","/Game/Gameplay/UI/V2/WBP_UIAlert.WBP_UIAlert_C","InterfaceLayers",4)]
    for name,cls,parent,index in specs:
        if name in nodes:
            assert ref(nodes[name]["widgetClassPath"])==cls and ref(nodes[name]["parent"])==ref(nodes[parent]["widget"]),("Preserve existing hierarchy",name)
    created=[]
    for name,cls,parent,index in specs:
        if name in nodes:continue
        node=call(U+"AddWidget",{"widgetBlueprint":BP,"widgetClass":{"refPath":cls},"widgetDisplayName":name,"parentWidget":nodes[parent]["widget"],"childIndex":index})
        assert node and node["widgetName"]==name
        nodes[name]=node;created.append(name)
        if parent=="InterfaceLayers":
            update(node["widget"],{"visibility":"Collapsed"})
            update(node["slot"],{"horizontalAlignment":"HAlign_Fill","verticalAlignment":"VAlign_Fill","padding":{"left":0,"top":0,"right":0,"bottom":0}})
        elif parent=="Screen_Loading":
            update(node["slot"],{"layoutData":{"offsets":{"left":0,"top":0,"right":0,"bottom":0},"anchors":{"minimum":{"x":0,"y":0},"maximum":{"x":1,"y":1}},"alignment":{"x":0,"y":0}},"bAutoSize":False})
    assert call(U+"CompileWidgetBlueprint",{"widgetBlueprint":BP})
    assert call(A+"save_assets",{"asset_paths":["/Game/Gameplay/UI/V2/WBP_UIRoot"]})
    final=call(U+"GetWidgets",{"widgetBlueprint":BP})
    names=[x["widgetName"] for x in final["widgets"]]
    assert all(x["widgetName"] in names for x in old["widgets"]),"Existing root widget lost"
    final_pages=[x["widgetName"] for x in final["widgets"] if ref(x["parent"])==ref(nodes["InterfaceScreens"]["widget"])]
    assert final_pages==expected,final_pages
    return {"created":created,"oldWidgetCount":len(old["widgets"]),"newWidgetCount":len(final["widgets"]),"pages":expected,"preservedExisting":True}
